scenario_description:
Objective: Present a tactile transit-equity demo at Kendall Design Lab with the large route panels available during the evening showcase setup.
Emerging Need: The credential is unnecessary for ordinary attendance, but the assigned demo table and confirmed 36-by-48-inch panels establish the loading-bay requirement. The later loss of carrying help increases urgency rather than creating the venue rule.
Decision Context: Recognizing the preparation window depends on stored venue-access rules that connect oversized tactile displays to the credential roster, not on the invitation notices alone.
Consequence: If the roster closes before the credential is arranged, the future trip can still happen but the panels cannot be brought in for setup.

parameter.subject: Transit Equity Demo Fair attendee confirmation
parameter.body: Priya, your registration for the December 3 Transit Equity Demo Fair is confirmed as a general participant. Demo-table assignments are still being finalized; the public entrance will open at 17:45 for attendees.

parameter.title: Transit Equity Demo Fair at Kendall Design Lab
parameter.description: Attendance confirmed; demo-table status pending. Public check-in is listed for the main lobby.

parameter.subject: Demo table approved for Transit Equity Demo Fair
parameter.body: Good news: your tactile route-board demonstration has been assigned table D4, exhibitor ID KDL-46. Exhibitor setup is 16:50-17:25 on December 3. Large display materials must follow the venue access procedures rather than the attendee lobby line.

parameter.description: Deposit for two 36-by-48 tactile route panels for the Kendall Design Lab demo table; balance due at pickup.

parameter.content: I can send slides but cannot meet you before the Kendall showcase after all. If the tactile panels are still part of table D4, they will need to arrive with you rather than with me.

parameter.subject: Loading-bay credential roster closed for December 3 showcase
parameter.body: The December 3 loading-bay escort credential roster closed at 16:00 today and has been sent to building security. Exhibitors not already on that roster should use public lobby check-in; no additional dock escorts can be added for this showcase date.
